question: Which country did India beat in the final to win the 2023 Intercontinental Cup Football championship?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lebanon**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India** won the **2023 Intercontinental Cup Football **championship by defeating **Lebanon** in the final.
 
• The final match was held on **June 18, 2023**, at the **Kalinga Stadium **in **Bhubaneswar, Odisha**.
 
• This victory marked a significant achievement for the Indian football team, showcasing their improved performance on the international stage.
 
• The Intercontinental Cup is an international football tournament organized by the **All India Football Federation (AIFF)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Indian football team, also known as the **Blue Tigers**, has shown consistent growth under the guidance of their coach, **Igor Štimac**.
 
• The tournament featured teams from various continents, providing a platform for competitive international exposure for the Indian team.
 
• India's victory in the Intercontinental Cup is seen as a positive step towards their preparations for upcoming international tournaments.
 
• The AIFF continues to focus on developing football infrastructure and talent in the country to elevate the sport to new heights.
